parsed.name: Zaber 电动位移台单轴
parsed.description: Zaber ASCII 协议控制的电动位移平台或线性执行器中的单个运动轴，用于实验中样品、光学元件或探头的精密定位、回零、相对/绝对位移和速度控制。
parsed.description_en: A single motion axis of a Zaber ASCII-controlled motorized stage or linear actuator, used in laboratories for precise positioning of samples, optical components, or probes, including homing, relative/absolute moves, and velocity control.

actions.description: 向该轴发送 ASCII 运动或查询命令。
actions.description_en: Send an ASCII motion or query command to this axis.

actions.description: 使该轴回零并建立参考位置。
actions.description_en: Home the axis to establish a reference position.

actions.description: 将该轴移动到指定绝对位置。
actions.description_en: Move the axis to a specified absolute position.

actions.description: 使该轴相对当前位置移动指定距离。
actions.description_en: Move the axis by a specified relative distance.

actions.description: 使该轴以指定速度连续运动。
actions.description_en: Move the axis continuously at a specified velocity.

actions.description: 等待该轴完成运动并进入空闲状态。
actions.description_en: Wait until the axis finishes moving and becomes idle.

actions.description: 将命令编码为设备可识别的 ASCII 报文。
actions.description_en: Encode a command into an ASCII message recognized by the device.

actions.description: 选择或获取指定编号的运动轴。
actions.description_en: Select or access a specified numbered axis.

actions.description: 向设备串口写入原始指令数据。
actions.description_en: Write raw command data to the device serial port.

actions.description: 从设备串口读取回复数据。
actions.description_en: Read reply data from the device serial port.

actions.description: 清空设备串口通信缓冲区。
actions.description_en: Flush the device serial communication buffer.

actions.description: 定义串口通信超时时间。

actions.description_en: Define the serial communication baud rate.
